title: PM-KISAN Scheme: Complete Enrollment Guide
content:
Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) provides ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families in three equal installments of ₹2,000.

Eligibility:
- Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable land up to 2 hectares (5 acres)
- All states except those with 100% income tax coverage

Ineligible:
- Income tax payers (previous assessment year)
- Serving/retired government employees (except Class IV)
- Constitutional post holders
- Professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs)
- Families holding constitutional posts

Documents needed: Aadhaar card, bank passbook (with IFSC), land records (khasra/khatoni), mobile number linked to Aadhaar.

How to apply: Visit pmkisan.gov.in → 'Farmer Corner' → 'New Farmer Registration'. Or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Enrollment is FREE — never pay anyone.

Check payment status: At pmkisan.gov.in → 'Beneficiary Status'. Or call PM-KISAN helpline: 155261 / 1800-115-526.
content_hi:
PM-KISAN पात्र किसान परिवारों को ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष (₹2,000 की तीन किस्तों में) प्रदान करता है।

पात्रता: 2 हेक्टेयर (5 एकड़) तक की कृषि भूमि वाले छोटे और सीमांत किसान।

दस्तावेज: आधार कार्ड, बैंक पासबुक, भूमि रिकॉर्ड, आधार से जुड़ा मोबाइल नंबर।

आवेदन: pmkisan.gov.in पर जाएं या नजदीकी CSC पर संपर्क करें।
summary: PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000/year in 3 installments. Eligible: farmers with ≤5 acres. Apply free at pmkisan.gov.in or CSC.
summary_hi: PM-KISAN सालाना ₹6,000 देता है। पात्र: 5 एकड़ तक के किसान। pmkisan.gov.in पर मुफ्त आवेदन करें।
actions: Check your eligibility: do you own less than 5 acres (2 hectares) of cultivable land?
Gather documents: Aadhaar card, bank passbook with IFSC code, land records (khasra/khatoni).
Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmer Corner.
Or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) — enrollment is COMPLETELY FREE.
After registration, check payment status at pmkisan.gov.in → Beneficiary Status — use your Aadhaar number.
warnings: PM-KISAN enrollment is FREE. Never pay anyone for registration — report fraud to 155261.
If your installment is delayed, check the beneficiary list on pmkisan.gov.in before assuming rejection.
Update your Aadhaar-bank linkage and land records if your application shows 'pending' for more than 3 months.
